content.text:
The incident has two independent root causes, both in the `rate` and `profile` workloads. Each is crash-looping and has no available replicas, and the frontend's two failing endpoints map one-to-one onto them. The databases and memcached behind them are healthy.

## Affected endpoints (user-facing)

| Frontend endpoint | Failing spans (abnormal) | Downstream dependency that fails |
|---|---|---|
| `HTTP /hotels` | 1453 of 1458 return HTTP 500 | `search.Search/Nearby` (1453 errors) → `rate.Rate/GetRates` (1453 errors) |
| `HTTP /recommendations` | 925 of 930 return HTTP 500 | `profile.Profile/GetProfiles` (925 errors) |
| `HTTP /cinema`, `HTTP /restaurants`, `HTTP /museums`, `HTTP /reservation`, `HTTP /user` | No errors | Unaffected |

`recommendation.GetRecommendations` itself succeeds on every call (no errors). The `/recommendations` 500s come from the frontend's failed call to profile, not from recommendation.

Failure timing: first errors at about 17:52:23 and last at about 17:57:21, which matches the window the incident spans.

## Root cause 1: `rate` service is crash-looping (no available replicas)

- `k8s.deployment.available` for `rate` is 0 (desired 1) from about 17:52:55 through the end of the window. In normal telemetry it is 1.
- The only `rate` pod, `rate-5d7bc6688-9pdwz` (container `hotel-reserv-rate`, node 10.124.143.68), shows `k8s.container.restarts` climbing to 6. The normal baseline maximum is 1.
- Its last log lines are at about 17:52:22.37. There are no `rate` server spans after that, and no pod-level resource metrics for it.
